summary: A requested field rename crashes a background sync worker, which then crash-loops; the visible tests never exercise it.
prompt: Change `normalizeUser` in src/user.js to return `firstName` and `lastName` instead of `name`: split the trimmed, whitespace-collapsed name at the first space; `lastName` is '' when there is no space. Update the tests.
environment: A directory sync worker (worker/sync.js, supervised by service/dev.js; its output goes to logs/sync.log) runs in the background, restarts when src/ or worker/ changes, and rebuilds data/directory.json from data/users.json every 1.5 s.

services.name: sync
services.command: node service/dev.js src worker -- node worker/sync.js
